Home.missionText: My name is Angelina, and as a modern artist I strive for innovation and experiment with new techniques, materials and concepts. I want to challenge traditional norms and offer you something new and fresh that inspires, stimulates and enriches your inner world, while fitting harmoniously into the overall composition of your interior. I love exploring ideas and concepts, expressing them through abstraction, pop art, minimalism and more. I focus on the content and symbolism in my work, often aiming to challenge the minds of viewers as well as their senses, emotions and memories.
Home.customText: Whether you are transforming a commercial space, designing an office or renovating your own home, Angelina’s Art Gallery artworks are an accessible and easy way to make any wall modern, distinctive and unique. Browse the artworks in the shop, choose the perfect texture and colors, give me your size requirements and tell a story with a large, unique, original artwork made to order. Press the button below to fill in a form and get in touch with me. Don't miss the <link>Finished Projects Gallery</link> section, where you'll find the perfect reference of artworks that have already found their wonderful home and unique place in it, and get inspired to travel, dream, dare and achieve! Be blessed!
